query:
UPDATE rulebook_sections SET
               fetch_error = $2,
               fetch_failures = fetch_failures + 1,
               last_checked_at = NOW(),
               next_check_at = NOW() + make_interval(
                   hours => LEAST(power(2, LEAST(fetch_failures, 16))::int, $3)
               )
           WHERE url = $1
           RETURNING fetch_failures
